verdict.rationale: Mercury is a hosted fintech banking service, and deployment model is still a fair question for a software product, so the axis applies. Every piece of evidence describes vendor-hosted endpoints: the production API, the hosted MCP URL at mcp.mercury.com, and a hosted sandbox. Nothing documents a self-hostable distribution of the core product; the open-source Go SDK, CLI and skills are client tooling, not a self-hosted core.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
